title: Chapter 446
paragraphs: Chapter 446
128. Zephyrin (2)
Zephyrin threw the axe-sword, and dark, long nails grew from her fingers. Those nails, which had stabbed the Black Knight, were her primary means of attack.

The purple magic shining ominously from her nails was fierce. As Zephyrin jumped, a sharp sound of cutting the air was heard. The nails she swung in a cross-shaped attack slashed the air and the group.
Jin defended with his sword, and Valkas with his fist, against her attack. Swords, fists, and nails tangled as sparks, aura, and fragments of magic flew everywhere.
Using a familiar weapon affects anyone. After discarding the axe-sword, Zephyrin's posture and balance improved, and her movements became lighter.
She had already felt like a formidable enemy, and now she seemed even stronger. The problem was the strong conviction that this was not the end.
She was a dragon.
She had not yet revealed her true form, and it was unknown what abilities she possessed as the 'Demon Dragon.'
'Even with the power she has shown now, it's at least 10 stars by human standards.'
It occurred to him that she might be a formidable foe, perhaps on par with his father, Chiron Runckandale.

Thankfully, Jin didn't feel the aura of an absolute powerhouse that only his father and Halfgod Vahn had among the people he had seen firsthand. But he couldn't tell if it really didn't exist or if he just couldn't feel it.
Swoosh!
Zephyrin pushed Jin and Valkas away and rushed at Murakan. Her purple nails sliced off one of his wings in one swift motion.
Her nails had cut through the spiritualized wing. The wing merely wavered like smoke, and Murakan didn't miss the opportunity to get close to her.
In an instant, Murakan's entire body turned into black smoke and enveloped Zephyrin. When the smoke reformed into Murakan, Zephyrin was trapped inside his wing.

From the outside, it wasn't visible, but in the folded wing, which was like a prison, torrents of spiritual power poured out like mad. The power pierced through flesh and bone, causing a creepy noise.
However, just as Murakan had spiritualized his body to avoid the attack, Zephyrin also used her magic to evade the onslaught.
The battle between dragons was different from human fights, separate from the high and low of martial arts.
[Well, among the Demon Dragons I've encountered, you seem to be the best. Were you hiding and living in fear a thousand years ago? I'm curious about where you've been rolling around.]
Zephyrin, who had scattered into purple smoke, appeared at a considerable distance from Murakan.
"Haha, how adorable. How can you dare to evaluate me like that? You still haven't grasped it, have you, Lord Murakan?"
Swoosh!
The sharp magic that extended from Zephyrin's nails this time cut Murakan's body in half.
He didn't suffer a significant blow thanks to spiritualization, but if his spiritual power continued to be consumed like this, Murakan would soon be exhausted.
"Even if I were facing you in your prime, I wouldn't have been that scared. The reason you don't know me well is that I couldn't fight you back then."
[Couldn't fight?]
"There were some circumstances, you know. Something you should know. No, actually, there's no way you could know, right?"
Fwoosh!
The waterfall of the Demonic Sword technique fell towards Zephyrin's head. At the same time, Valkas put all his strength into a punch.
The space around them distorted due to the energy and aura of the two. The waterfall struck the ground, and the punch tore through the air.

Zephyrin threw her body to dodge, and Murakan swooped in like a hawk, breathing out his dark breath. The black breath engulfed Zephyrin, but after it dispersed, she seemed to have not taken much damage.
However, before the crash, the Demonic Sword technique of Thunderstorm that Jin had prepared and Valkas' dark king's secret technique had taken effect.
Dozens of lightning blades formed on the ground, and the massive aura from Valkas' fist enveloped the falling Zephyrin.
This time, Zephyrin couldn't transform her body into magic in time. The Thunderstorm blades cut her body in various places, and Valkas' fist struck her squarely in the middle of her back.
"Argh!"
With a deafening impact sound, Zephyrin spat out a mouthful of blood and was flung to the other side of the group.

If she had been human, it would have been a fatal blow, with shattered bones and organs. However, the group sensed that she hadn't suffered much damage as she was slammed into the wall of the pocket dimension. Even her pained cry seemed almost playful.
Murakan transformed into a human and stood next to Jin.
"Murakan."
"Yeah."
"Do you really have no idea who that demonic dragon is?"
"Yeah. I thought she might be one of the guardian dragons of the demon race of Rontelgius that you killed, but she seems to be beyond that."
"Any guesses?"
"A direct dragon under a demon god-level being. That's for sure."
Can we win?
Jin didn't voice that question out loud, as it had been a long time since he had seen Murakan with such a serious expression.
An unexpected disaster.
Zephyrin was such a being. It was baffling to think what kind of connection there could be between the weakened demons they had easily killed at Joshua's villa and Zephyrin.
'Did she really hold a grudge against me for the magic book I obtained back then?'
When they first suspected Zephyrin to be a demonic dragon at the Sword Emperor's banquet.
Jin and his friends naturally thought that she (as a demonic dragon) had deliberately and cautiously approached them because of the magic book.
It seemed unlikely that they would be involved with demons or demonic dragons otherwise.
However, Zephyrin was now acting as if she didn't care about the magic book at all.
'Or maybe after putting Murakan to sleep and killing the Dark King, she thinks she can find out about the magic book anytime... No, wait a minute.'
At that moment, Jin recalled that Zephyrin had clearly expressed her intent to kill only the Dark King.
'Murakan was going to be put to sleep, and I don't seem to be in a situation where I'll be killed.'
Why go to such lengths?
Jin soon thought of a case.
'- This ambush is commendable. But you and your god will become the most important ingredients for the Demonic Stone, Jin Runcandel...!'
The words spoken by Andrei Zipfel when using the Demonic Stone during his time as a reserve knight.
'Back then, Andrei seemed to regard Solderet's power as the core of the Demonic Stone.'
Looking back, those seeking the Demonic Stone, or a similarly mysterious power, tended to be oddly obsessed with the 'Contract of Solderet'.
Notable examples of this fact include Andrei in Zipfel and Joshua in Runcandel.
Moreover, considering that the creator of the 'Demonic Stone' was Bubare Gaston, Solderet's power must hold very special value for their great undertaking in Kinzelo.
'That's why the Kinzelo guys kept trying to recruit me.'
Creak, crack!
Zephyrin was getting up, recovering her grotesquely twisted and cut body. In an instant, her bones found their place, and her torn wounds vanished without a trace.
It seemed like Zephyrin could regenerate even if her entire body was torn apart, just like the Kinzelo leader during the Sword Emperor's Castle terror.
Kinzelo.
Jin soon had a feeling that Zephyrin was likely affiliated with that insane group.

'If it were Zipfel, they would have acted together with the ghost group. However, if she is affiliated with Kinzelo, there's something I find hard to accept. Zephyrin's actions are completely different from the attitude Kinzelo has shown me so far.'
While Jin despised Kinzelo, they always showed a generous side towards him.
Attacking Jin suddenly like this was clearly not in line with their usual behavior.
"I think she might be the dragon of the Kinzelo leader."
"That disgusting guy? It's possible. The power he showed during the Sword Emperor's Castle terror was divine."
"… Murakan-nim, and the 12th generation. If the battle drags on, there seems to be no answer."
When Valkas spoke, Jin nodded.
In the back, the Black Knight was dying, and Zephyrin was showing monstrous regeneration even when her entire body was crushed. Moreover, she didn't even seem tired.
"If it drags on, there's no answer? It's not just that. We can't win against that at all."
At Murakan's words, Jin and Valkas' eyes widened.
Jin was especially surprised. He had never imagined that the prideful Murakan would accept defeat so easily.
Anyway.
Since Murakan said so, there was no need to worry, and there was only one answer.
"We need to run away."
As Jin spoke, Murakan nodded, and Valkas' eyes wavered for a moment.
This place was the Black King's mines, and nothing was more precious to Valkas than the lives of his subordinates. Abandoning his subordinates and running away was unthinkable.
Valkas believed that if they fled, Zephyrin would not leave the Black King's mines alone. She possessed enough power to destroy the mines in a short time on her own.
The numerous defensive equipment and traps in the Black King's mines would be meaningless in front of that terrible demon dragon.
"I cannot run away, Murakan-nim."
"I know, my child. Who said we'd leave everyone behind and run away?"
"Then...?"
"I'll somehow hold her back, and you escape with the kid and lead the others. I'll shake her off and join you after that."
"Murakan."
"What?"
"Will you be okay on your own?"
Of course, Jin, Valkas, and Murakan had not yet used all of their power.
Even when the three of them fought together, the enemy was overwhelming. It was inevitable to worry if Murakan could handle Zephyrin on his own.
Hahaha!
Suddenly, Murakan burst into laughter.
"Even though I'm in this state, I've regained about 40% of my original power, kid. Even if it's not a demon dragon but a demon beast king like Orgal, I can handle it."
"I don't really trust that."
"Don't worry, I won't die before you. And this is the best we can do anyway, you know."
Murakan pointed to one side of the void space and continued his words.
"First, destroy this void space. You've done this a lot, so you know how, right?"
Sword of Light Technique 1: Soul Cutting and Tess's power. When cutting through unwanted otherworldly spaces, they had never disappointed Jin.
Huuuung...!
An enormous amount of spirit energy began to gather toward Murakan. Spirit energy liberation – as if soaked in black ink, the purple void space rapidly darkened.
It was, quite literally, the deployment of Murakan's current power.
[Hey, Zephyrin. Let's have a good time together as dragons. I'll personally evaluate whether your claim to be able to compete with me in my heyday is true or not.]
